annotations.title: Bring over bookings and class history

description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 bookings at once, past (with attendance) or upcoming. Each row names the class by class_id, or by date, time and class_type_id; a past class that is not on the calendar is created. An upcoming class must already be on the calendar. Nothing is emailed and no pack is charged again (classes_used on the imported pack already counts them); the booking is linked to the member’s pack so a later cancellation gives the class back. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

class_id.description: Id of a class on the calendar. Or give date, time and class_type_id instead.

duration_minutes.description: Only used when a class has to be created. Default 60.

external_id.description: The booking’s id in the old system.

free.description: True = not booked with a pack (gift, free class).

guest_name.description: For a person without an account. Leave out the member fields.

instructor_id.description: Only used when a past class has to be created.

member_pack_id.description: The member pack it was booked with.

pack_external_id.description: Or the external_id the member’s pack was imported with. Without either, the member’s pack that covered that day is linked.

status.description: Default: attended for past classes, booked for future ones. Future classes take only booked or cancelled.

time.description: Start time HH:MM, venue local time.

name: import_bookings
